name: Jester's Mask
desc: A mask worn on stage by jesters. Originally used as a tool to hide a jester's face and entertain crowds, it has recently become an object of fear after being used by thieves and assassins.

eff.name: Trickster
eff.desc1: Boosts critical rate by [Lv. x 3]% and increases critical damage by [Lv. x 3]%.

eff.name: Jack-in-the-Box
eff.desc1: Reduces the chances of being targeted by an attack by [Lv. x 5]%, and increases damage by [Lv. x 3]% when attacking a target from behind.

eff.name: Silent Steps
eff.desc1: Boosts character's movement speed by [Lv. x 2]%.
